source_name: CBK / BQK — English-language legal texts (?lang=en PDF variants)
why_relevant: Confirmed English translations of Kosovo financial legislation published by the regulator itself — e.g. Law No. 04/L-093 on Banks, MFIs and NBFIs as printed in Official Gazette No. 11 of 11 May 2012, plus reporting manuals. Essential for the cell's 'English translations' leg, and the ?lang= query-string convention generalises across the CBK document library.

source_name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine — snapshots of bqk-kos.org and gzk.rks-gov.net
why_relevant: The only practical way to recover CBK rule pages and PDFs that were removed or replaced in place. Confirmed via the availability API that a 200-status snapshot of the CBK legal-framework page exists (2020-08-10T18:08:07Z), so the domain is genuinely covered rather than robots-excluded. Also the fallback when a live fetch 403s.

source_name: Government Legislative Programme — Programi i Projektligjeve të Qeverisë 2025–2027 (Office of the Prime Minister)
why_relevant: Forward calendar of every draft law the government intends to table, by sponsoring ministry and quarter — approved by Government Decision No. 03/247 of 31 Jan 2025. It names financial-sector bills before any consultation opens, so it is the earliest deadline signal available and a map of which ministry owns which payments/banking file.

source_name: PKIE — Programi Kombëtar për Zbatimin e MSA-së / National Programme for EU Integration 2024–2028
why_relevant: The SAA-implementation programme assigns dated obligations for aligning Kosovo law with the EU acquis, including financial-services chapters. It supplies the 'by when and against which EU instrument' half of a deadline that domestic sources state only vaguely.

source_name: Rregullorja Nr. 05/2016 për Standardet Minimale të Procesit të Konsultimit Publik + Udhëzuesi për procesin e konsultimeve publike
why_relevant: The rulebook that defines what a Kosovo consultation legally is: minimum comment periods, mandatory publication on the platform, and the duty to publish a results report. Without it you cannot tell whether an observed short deadline is normal or a procedural shortcut worth flagging.

source_name: Municipal public-consultation pages (Konsultime Publike, kk.rks-gov.net)
why_relevant: Municipalities run parallel consultation pages on the kk.rks-gov.net template. Rarely banking-specific, but they carry local fee/levy and municipal-finance acts that touch payment collection, and they demonstrate the pattern /{municipality}/konsultime-publike/ across ~38 municipalities.

source_name: EU Publications Office — European Forum of Official Gazettes: Republic of Kosovo entry
why_relevant: Independent European description of Kosovo's official gazette: which publisher, what is authentic, whether the electronic version has legal force. Useful for judging evidentiary weight of a GZK text and for confirming the canonical gazette endpoint from a non-Kosovo source.

source_name: US Library of Congress — Guide to Law Online: Kosovo (legal guides)
why_relevant: Curated pointer list of Kosovo legal-research entry points, including gazette, assembly and translation sources. Classic snowball node that surfaces aggregators no topical query would reach, and is maintained by law librarians rather than a vendor.

source_name: GLOBALCIT national legislation database — Kosovo English law texts
why_relevant: Third-party mirror holding English Official Gazette texts of Kosovo laws as PDFs with stable academic hosting. Valuable precisely when the Kosovo-side copy has been withdrawn — a genuine off-site archive of superseded English versions. Scope is citizenship-centred, so financial-sector coverage is partial.

source_name: US State Department — Investment Climate Statement: Kosovo
why_relevant: Annual English narrative of Kosovo's financial-sector legal framework that names recently adopted and pending laws. Useful as an independent cross-check that a rule change actually happened and as a plain-English bridge to the Albanian text; not a substitute for primary sources.

source_name: Zyra e Qeverisjes së Mirë / ZQM — public-consultation news channel
why_relevant: The Office for Good Governance owns the consultation platform and announces platform changes, annual consultation reports and compliance findings there. It is the place where a change to how consultations are published (and therefore to your collector) would be flagged first.

source_name: BQK — Institucionet Financiare të Licencuara (Licensed Financial Institutions landing page)
why_relevant: Canonical CBK hub page from which the consolidated register PDF of all licensed/registered financial institutions is published; it maps the full regulated population (banks, MFIs, NBFIs, insurers, intermediaries, pension funds, payment/e-money institutions) that every later workstream needs as an entity spine.

source_name: BQK — Lista e institucioneve financiare të licencuara/regjistruara (dated consolidated register PDF, ALB)
why_relevant: The actual machine-harvestable register artefact: name, address, contact of every licensed bank, MFI, NBFI, insurer, insurance intermediary, pension fund and money-transfer/exchange entity, versioned by date in the URL. This is the highest-value single file in the cell.

source_name: BQK — Licencimi i Bankave (bank licensing section)
why_relevant: Sector-specific licensing sub-page: licensing criteria, application manuals and the bank sub-register. Signals entry/exit of banks and the procedural deadlines applicants face.

source_name: BQK — Fondet Pensionale (pension fund licensing/supervision sub-page)
why_relevant: Sub-register for the small but systemically relevant pension segment (Trusti + supplementary providers); confirms a second CBK URL path variant (mbikeqyrja-financiare-2) that a crawler must cover.

source_name: BQK — Kredidhënësit / Credit Providers list (Credit Registry section)
why_relevant: Operational list of all institutions reporting into the Kosovo Credit Registry — a second, independently maintained population of regulated lenders that can be diffed against the licensing register to catch omissions or lagging updates.

source_name: BQK — Divizioni i Regjistrit të Kredive dhe Regjistrit të Llogarive Bankare
why_relevant: Describes the Credit Registry and the Bank Account Registry, both of which impose mandatory reporting obligations (and therefore recurring deadlines) on every licensed lender/PSP — a pointer to the reporting-obligation layer of supervision.

source_name: BQK — Raporti Vjetor i BQK-së (CBK Annual Report, incl. supervision chapter)
why_relevant: The annual report contains the supervisory-activity chapter, including counts and descriptions of administrative-punitive measures imposed on financial institutions and related parties (e.g. seven such cases reported for 2020). In the absence of a per-case enforcement bulletin, this is the primary systematic record of enforcement in Kosovo.

source_name: BQK — Godišnji Izveštaj (CBK Annual Report, Serbian edition)
why_relevant: Serbian-language edition of the annual report — the main confirmed sr-language CBK artefact found. Establishes the sr terminology set (nadzor, licencirane banke, kaznene mere) needed for Serbian-language monitoring of Kosovo supervision.

source_name: BQK — Raporti i Informatave Mujore të Sistemit Financiar (Monthly Financial System Information Report)
why_relevant: Monthly series (published since Jan 2014) with per-sector data on banking, microfinance, insurance and pensions — the highest-frequency official signal of the regulated population's size and composition, and a fast tripwire for entity entry/exit between register PDF vintages.

source_name: BQK — Korniza Ligjore / Rregulloret: Sistemi i Pagesave (payments regulation index)
why_relevant: Index of all payment-system regulations (agents of PSPs, e-money issuance, non-bank PSP access to payment systems, SEPA). Each regulation carries compliance deadlines and defines which entities must appear in registers — a pointer hub for the payments half of the cell.

source_name: BQK — News / Lajme (CBK newsroom, incl. Board decisions)
why_relevant: Where CBK announces Board-approved regulations, licence grants/revocations and supervisory decisions first (e.g. the Board approving the Kosovo Interbank Payment System regulation). It is the fastest-moving official tripwire and it points to the underlying decision documents.

source_name: BQK — Manuali i Licencimit Bankar / Manuali i Regjistrimit të IMF dhe IFJB / Manuali i Licencimit të Siguruesve
why_relevant: Licensing manuals define the application procedure, documentary requirements and statutory decision deadlines for banks, MFIs/NBFIs and insurers — the procedural spine behind every register entry and a direct source of 'deadlines' content.

source_name: Regjistri Qendror i Lejeve dhe Licencave (RQLL) — Kosovo Central Register of Permits and Licences
why_relevant: Whole-of-government register (Law No. 04/L-202) cataloguing every licence type issued by central institutions, including CBK financial licences, with per-licence detail pages, legal basis and attached manuals. It is an independent cross-check on what CBK licence categories formally exist, and its search/detail URLs are stable and crawlable.

source_name: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës (GZK) — Official Gazette
why_relevant: Publishes the primary laws that constitute the register and enforcement powers — notably Law No. 04/L-093 on Banks, Microfinance Institutions and Non-Bank Financial Institutions (which mandates the public central register of financial institutions and the list of annulled licences), plus the CBK Law and the Crypto-Assets Law No. 08/L-295. Authoritative, machine-addressable by ActID.

source_name: Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës / Kosovo Banking Association — Anëtarët (members page)
why_relevant: Industry-side mirror of the licensed bank population, with member profiles and links to each bank's own site. Useful as an independent cross-check on the CBK register and as the entry point to the downstream publishers (individual banks) that this pointer cell is meant to enumerate; its komunikatat feed also carries sector positions on new regulation.

source_name: Byroja Kosovare e Sigurimit (BKS) — Kosovo Insurance Bureau
why_relevant: Statutory body (Law No. 04/L-018 on compulsory motor liability insurance) constituted by the licensed insurers; its member and correspondent lists mirror the CBK insurance register and its site carries sector-level compliance notices. Pointer into the insurance half of the regulated population.
